name: Norra (level 2)
text: Keywords: Elusive. Your Mysterious Portals now summon 4, 5, 6, or 7 cost followers instead. Nexus Strike: Plant a Mysterious Portal in the top 4 cards of your deck.

name: Seraphine (level 2)
text: Keywords: Missing Translation. When I'm summoned, create a random new 2 cost spell in hand. When you play a new spell that costs 2 or less, copy it with the same targets.

name: Mordekaiser (level 2)
text: Keywords: Challenger. Play: Kill up to 2 allies. When you slay another ally, revive it. Attack: For the rest of the game, when you slay a unit, Drain 1 from the enemy Nexus.

name: Nilah (level 2)
text: Keywords: Brash. Attack: Create a Slipstream in the top 6 cards of your deck and deal 2 damage to all enemies and the enemy Nexus. They cannot drop below 1 Health from this damage.

text: Keywords: Quick Attack, Spirit. When I'm summoned or Strike: Create a Dream-Laden Bough in hand or, if you have one, reduce its cost by 1. When you Sleep another ally, immediately wake it up and grant it Spirit.

name: Crimson Pact
